name: Voice Orchard
workflow: participant nominations -> local semantic topic approvals -> mandatory review -> exact PAV k-topic shortlist and complete participant coverage exports

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Swing Commons
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Reconcile informal voting-block notes with real local MiniLM group inference. Review mandates and weights, compare exact decisive-coalition Banzhaf power with nominal vote shares, and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown plus coalition witnesses without uploads or votes.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Thread Atelier
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Turn unordered workshop activity cards into a reviewed timed agenda with real local MiniLM embeddings and exact topical-link sequencing. Pin the opener, closer and prerequisites, edit every position, inspect evidence and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or invitations.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Replica Compass
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Classify rough read/write workload notes with real local MiniLM inference. Review counts and node assumptions, enumerate intersecting quorums under an offline-node target, compare assumed latency with all-node acknowledgements and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or configuration changes.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Quorum Canopy
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Reconcile both ends of rough proxy notes with real local MiniLM member inference. Verify mandates, trace chains to attending representatives, block cycles and cap breaches, compare weighted quorum against direct attendance and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or votes.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Decision Estuary
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Reconcile both sides of pairwise feedback with real local MiniLM inference. Review option identities and vote counts, expose preference cycles and missing comparisons, compare strongest-path tiers against direct wins and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or automatic decisions.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Delegate Loom
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Reconcile informal club chapter reports with real local MiniLM inference. Verify membership counts, compare exact proportional delegate-seat apportionment against equal allocation and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or appointments.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Ballot Bridge
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Reconcile ranked write-in preferences with real local MiniLM option matching. Review or hold each whole ballot, inspect instant-runoff transfers and ties, and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown tally audits without uploads.

nearestEarlierUtilities.name: Agenda Loom
nearestEarlierUtilities.desc: Turn meeting proposals into a time-budgeted agenda with real local MiniLM overlap detection and grouped priority optimization. Review semantic groups, edit or undo choices, preserve the parking lot and export reviewed JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploading content.

distinction: Unlike ranked single-winner IRV, pairwise option comparisons, population seat apportionment, or timed agenda sequencing/overlap selection, this maximizes harmonic approval representation across a fixed-size multi-topic subset with equal participant ballots; preserves unrepresented people.
